description: Ministry of Higher Education & Highways - Order made to revoke the status of Degree Awarding that Published in Ex. Ord. Gaz. No. 536/15 of 15.12.1998 for the Technological Studies (Pvt) Ltd.
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the revocation of a previous order under the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978, which is a legal/regulatory action. It deals with statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks for higher education institutions, specifically regarding the recognition of a degree-awarding institute. While it mentions a minister's name, it does not contain detailed portfolio responsibilities or personnel changes, but rather focuses on the exercise of legal powers under existing legislation.
